text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Ryan and I are walking
through the
shopping district one
evening...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Look, Trainer. There's a bunch of
people
over there. Is there a sale on
protein powder or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The sporty Umamusume over there! Care
to try
your luck?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A raffle! Hey, Trainer, didn't we just get
some
vouchers for this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you need one ticket or five
vouchers to
enter! If we put ours
together, we can take a shot
at it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya mean? You only have one shot
in a race
too! This kind of tension is
exactly what brings
out my inner flex.
choice_data_list: 1回だけじゃ、期待はできないか？
1回だけじゃ、期待はできないかな？
choice_data_list_en: Maybe we shouldn't expect too much from just one try?
Maybe we shouldn't expect too much from just one try?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn that wheel like pros! Grab the
handle
and get swole!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah, I should be careful...
choice_data_list_en: ...Try not to break the raffle drum, okay?
...Try not to break the raffle drum, all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heeding my warning, we grab the lever
together
and turn the spinner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
ticket for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... I mean, this can't be
real, can
it?
choice_data_list: なんで固まってるんだ？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was only acting like that to get myself
pumped
up. I never believed that I'd
have such luck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I won... the grand-prize?! For real?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's having trouble
accepting this
sudden turn of good
fortune.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A ticket for a hot spring trip! G-geez,
what should
I do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Honestly, I don't know how to
handle
something like this... Hrm...
choice_data_list: メジロライアンが好きに使っていいぞ
メジロライアンが好きに使っていいよ
choice_data_list_en: Mejiro Ryan, you can use it however you like.
Mejiro Ryan, feel free to use it however you like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I don't deserve to take a vacation
like that!
choice_data_list: 誰かと骨休めにでも行ってきたら？
choice_data_list_en: Why don't you take a break and relax with someone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm still in the middle of my racing
journey...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not on great terms with
McQueen right
now, even though I
really wanna chat with her. I
can't just
invite her on a trip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's not right. That wouldn't be helpful
for either
of us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the stubborn-headed Mejiro Ryan, a
hot
spring vacation is a frivolous
distraction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uh, Trainer... Could you hold onto this
ticket for
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't even know how I'd use it right
now. And...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think it's because I don't deserve to use
it yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, I'm sure I'll know.
And I'll
work my hardest to reach that
point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! It's only until I gain enough
confidence to
feel comfortable taking
time off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made her decision, Ryan looks
up at the
sky. I'll hold onto the hot
spring ticket until she's
achieved
something great.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
First-prize?! Woo! I can't believe I won
something
so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A deluxe carrot hamburger steak! That's
like
getting top-tier whey protein!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sure I get the comparison, but
it does
sound pricey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! How could you say that?!
choice_data_list: とはいえ、ハンバーグはハンバーグか
とはいえ、ハンバーグはハンバーグだよね
choice_data_list_en: That said, a hamburger steak is still a hamburger steak, huh.
That said, a hamburger steak is a hamburger steak, right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Look at that fine piece of meat being
displayed
on the prize stand!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Meat like this exudes confidence! Just
look at
how lean and low in fat it is! It
has a natural
umami flavor as well,
removing any need for
special seasoning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And look at that carrot in the middle!
The deep
color is proof that it's packed
full of nutrients!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A hamburger steak with such a generous
amount
of ingredients... I would never
have the courage
to make this for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But bravo to the people who did! Thanks
to them,
I get to eat an extremely
healthy power food!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that to Mejiro Ryan, at least,
this prize is
quite valuable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this year's off to a great start! I'm
gonna
eat my fill and train hard!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! A bushel of carrots! That's still a
pretty
great prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They must be in that cardboard box over
there...
Whoa, it's like a mountain of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'm used to carrying big
boxes
from all the stuff I buy in bulk.
choice_data_list_en: I wonder if I can carry it home?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This box is gonna be a piece of cake. In
fact, I'm
sure I could carry another one
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Raffle Man, can I carry this other
box too?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, now. You've only won one
case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I get it! Oops, sorry about the

misunderstanding!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a powerlifting competition.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A single case is plenty enough.
Afterward, Mejiro
Ryan and I chow down
on some delicious carrots.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A carrot! A single carrot! Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's about all I expected really. Even if
I turned
the spinner with all my might,
there was no
guarantee I'd win a good
prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It may be just one carrot,
but I
shouldn't make light of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You don't know how hard this carrot had
to work
out to gain such a bright color!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it like that though... It
does make
it harder to eat. Sorry, my
little carrot friend...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's feeling sympathy for the carrot...
But we
decide to enjoy it anyway, and
let it nourish us
for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, that's a blank—tough luck! Here's
this pack
of tissues as a consolation prize

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aww... Tissues? What a letdown...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You know, whenever I see tissues, it
always
reminds me of something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen always carries both a cute
handkerchief
and some pocket tissues
with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just carry a sports towel around. That's
plenty
enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Maybe I should take this chance to change up my habits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is what it is, and tissues are tissues...
But it sure
would have been nice to win
a better prize.
